entities.name: UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: NAS message for uplink transport of payload from UE to network.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer controlling when UE is allowed to send UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT under certain conditions.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: Timer controlling when UE is allowed to send UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT in EMM-CONNECTED mode after attach without PDN connection.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: EMM state where UE has an active NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: UE configured to use AC11 15 in selected PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured with access class 11-15 in the selected PLMN.

entities.name: PDN connection for emergency bearer services established
entities.description: Condition where UE has an established PDN connection for emergency services.

entities.name: UE configured for dual priority with specific conditions
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for dual priority and has PDN connection without low access priority but T3346 started for low priority request.

entities.name: Network initiated signalling message received
entities.description: Condition where UE has received a network-initiated signalling message.

entities.name: UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT sending allowed
entities.description: Property indicating when UE is permitted to send UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT message.

relations.description: Timer T3346 running prevents sending UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT except under specific conditions.
Timer T3447 running prevents sending UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT in EMM-CONNECTED mode after attach without PDN connection except under specific conditions.
UE configured with AC11-15 allows sending UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT even when T3346 or T3447 is running.
Emergency PDN connection established allows sending UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT when T3346 is running.
Dual priority configuration with specific conditions allows sending UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT when T3346 is running.
Network initiated signalling message received allows sending UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT when T3447 is running.
Sending UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT when T3447 is running requires consideration of EMM-CONNECTED state after attach without PDN connection.
Timer T3346 expiry or stopping allows sending UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT if still necessary.
Timer T3447 expiry allows sending UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT if still necessary.
